items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Abbott, Robert Abbott was the owner of Chicago Defender, and he -- well, he was a nice man

ctx.x: White people bought up the Tattler and the -- all the papers, the colored papers, and I tell you, you know, Mr. Abbott, Robert Abbott was the owner of Chicago Defender, and he -- well, he was a nice man, and he always saw that everything was up to the minute in the paper, you
know? And he had some wonderful writers -- critics and all, you know, they were wonderful, wonderful people.
